name: Master Strategy Deck Building Set (Gholdengo ex)

releases.name: Master Strategy Deck Building Set (Gholdengo ex)

description.text: The Master Strategy Deck Building Set (大师战略卡组构筑套装) Gholdengo ex is a box for players who want to start battling quickly and keep improving a deck, one of three released on 16 July 2026 with the Raging Bolt ex, Dragapult ex and Gholdengo ex decks, following the first three of January 2026. It holds a ready-built 60-card Gholdengo ex deck, with Gholdengo ex, Mew ex and Dudunsparce among its Pokémon, Buddy-Buddy Poffin, Superior Energy Retrieval and Ciphermaniac's Codebreaking among its Trainers, and the ACE SPEC Prime Catcher. Pokémon China pitched it at players who like to keep recycling their resources and knock out the opponent's Pokémon with ease. With it come a sheet on how the deck plays, a 15-card modification pack and a guide to changing the deck, four 20-card Chasing Glory (共逐荣光) packs to change it further, with all kinds of Trainer's Pokémon, a set of 64 card sleeves in one of eight designs at random, a Gholdengo deck box with two dividers, a coin die, six metal damage-counter dice and Poison and Burn markers. Its cards are numbered out of 32.

sources.title: Pokémon China: The new Master Strategy Deck Building Sets: Raging Bolt ex, Dragapult ex and Gholdengo ex (29 June 2026)
